name: 4: 42-day QP not reached; remove earnings
description: Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (730-day planned duration, qualifying period = 42 days), approves it, then records a withdrawal after 30 days in learning. Because 30 < 42, earnings for periods prior to the withdrawal date should be removed.

steps.name: SLD Records Withdrawal (30 days in learning — below 42-day qualifying period)
